candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of games of chance, gambling establishments, and betting activities.
This vector represents common German action verbs in various conjugated and infinitive forms.
This vector represents abstract concepts, challenges, and occurrences related to human activities and natural phenomena.
This vector represents concepts of difference, distinction, and variation across various forms and attributes.
This vector activates on non-English characters, including Arabic diacritics, accented Latin letters, and fragments from French, German, and Polish words.
This vector activates for roots and prefixes of academic, mathematical, and analytical terminology.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to words related to gambling, betting, and gaming.
This feature vector represents common German verb roots and morphological stems.
German demonstrative and relative determiners, particularly forms of "dieser" and related grammatical suffixes.
This vector activates for German words and lexical roots starting with the prefix "ge-".
